title.narrative: Catalyzing market transformation for industrial energy efficiency and accelerate investments in best available practices and technologies in the Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia

description.narrative: Project Objective: To accelerate market transformation for industrial energy efficiency by strengthening policy, regulatory and institutional frameworks and supporting increased diffusion of and investment in best available industrial energy efficiency practices and technologies. Project Component 1 - Strengthening Macedonian policy, regulatory and institutional frameworks and capacity for market transformation for industrial energy efficiency and green industry. Project Component 2 - Market development support for deployment and diffusion of best available practices and technologies for energy efficiency and environmental sustainability in industry. Project Component 3 - Enhancing existing financing facilities to boost investments in energy efficiency and low carbon technologies for industry
